HYBRID: This course will be held online but students who are on campus may attend in person.
This seminar explores theoretical and practical dimensions of GIS project management in a professional setting. Through readings and invited speakers, the course introduces students to diverse applications of geospatial technologies in business, non-profit, and governmental organizations, and how GIS projects are created, planned, and managed.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to MS:Geog:Geog Info Sci PSM-UIUC.
